object.attr: as implemented: mapped from the existing tests, with blind tests written from the requirements alone for what they missed.
object.description: Make a repository holding two documents, PARENT and CHILD, where CHILD declares PARENT as its parent document. Leave CHILD's only object file the way a conflicted git merge leaves it, with conflict markers from line 3. Call the MCP server's validate_repo tool and its repo_health tool. Expected: each returns one load error, for CHILD, naming the file CHILD/objects/CHILD-0.xml, line 3 and a reason that ends with '(unresolved merge conflict?)'; the documents validated or counted are PARENT alone, so CHILD gets no validation result; validate_repo returns ok false. Also open a Document Editor on req-test's VCU3-SRS, then leave conflict markers in one of its object files and choose the Validate action. Expected: the load error, naming that file and a merge conflict, and no 'validation passed'.
